g.title: MlQube: GitOps hub and spoke
g.text: 6 · One Argo CD in the management cluster deploys to every cluster · workload clusters run no Argo CD

g.title: cluster_Workload cluster: non-prod, a spoke (no Argo CD)
g.text: Workload cluster: non-prod, a spoke (no Argo CD)

a.xlink:title: ⑦ one UI for all clusters
① access entry for Argo CD's role

g.title: legend
g.text: Terraform installs Argo CD in the hub and registers each workload cluster: a cluster secret in Argo CD, an EKS access entry in the spoke
Argo CD pulls the GitOps repository (read-only deploy key): the desired state of every cluster
An ApplicationSet (cluster generator) creates one Application per add-on per registered cluster, with that cluster's values
Argo CD applies the hub's own add-ons and platform tools in-cluster
Argo CD applies to the spoke: Pod Identity credentials, private API over VPC peering, authorized by the access entry
Prod (later) is registered the same way; in a separate AWS account through a cross-account role
The platform team sees and operates every cluster in one Argo CD UI (private URL, single sign-on later)
Applied by Argo CD (dashed: later phases)
